summary: Initializes the AI difficulty database object from built-in constants and an on-disk AI database file. Seeds track-position speed-curve slots (3.0/1.0/2.0), zeroes three slots, sets low/mid/high aggression baselines (0.5/1.0/1.3) and configuration integers (1/104/52/3), opens the AI database file path (with a dword_7CE608/byte_5EA438 fallback source), then interpolates a difficulty-scaled output into this[70] from dword_7D01A0. Called once from Game_Init (0x0042D6B0).

local_names.this: AI difficulty database configuration object (float-typed in decompiler)
local_names.v5/v6: result of the database file-open call and its duplicate handle

operations.description: Guard on StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_14, 2022); when it returns nonzero the init proceeds to the log-entry step.
When the split guard passes, write an entry trace via DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredAidatab).

Loop v2 from 0 while v2 < 3, writing this[v2 + 79] with 3.0 on the first iteration and the prior index value (1.0, 2.0) afterwards, seeding the three track-position speed-curve slots starting at offset 0x13C.
Zero the three slots this[76], this[77], this[78] (offsets 0x130, 0x134, 0x138).
Set the difficulty aggression baselines this[71] = 0.5 (0x11C), this[72] = 1.0 (0x120), this[73] = 1.3 (0x124).
Write configuration integers as dword indices: this[87] = 1 (0x15C), this[88] = 104 (0x160), this[89] = 52 (0x164), this[90] = 3 (0x168).
Set base aggressiveness multiplier *this = 4.75 (0x0) and secondary multiplier this[1] = 4.3125 (0x4).
Guard StringCopyWithValidation(this + 6, 256, aAiDatabaseFile, 0); on success copy the configured AI database file name into the file buffer.
Copy the AI database file path: source is dword_7CE608 when set, otherwise the fallback byte_5EA438, written via sub_587DD0(this + 6, source, 200).
Open the database file with sub_587DB0(this + 6, aRt); when it returns nonzero, process it via sub_402690(this, v5) and close with FileCloseWithLock(v6).

Interpolate the difficulty-scaled output into this[70] (0x118): when dword_7D01A0 > 100 blend between this[72] and this[73] with result = dword_7D01A0 - 100 scaled by 0.05, otherwise blend between this[71] and this[72] with result = dword_7D01A0 - 70 scaled by 0.0333.
Invoked from Game_Init (0x0042D6B0) during game initialization.
Return the difficulty difference value (dword_7D01A0 minus 100 or 70).
